audit.title: Audit log
audit.text: Every change in this organization, and every page your service provider opened during support access.
audit.empty_text: Changes and support visits will appear here as they happen.

filters.none_text: Try a longer period or another area.

report.empty_text: Pick a longer period, or come back once there is activity.

exports.requested: The export is being prepared. It appears below when it is ready.
exports.empty_text: Choose a period and prepare a CSV file to open in a spreadsheet.
exports.note: Up to a year per file. The file can be downloaded for a few days, then it is deleted; every download is recorded here.

support.title: Support access
support.text: Your service provider can look inside only when you allow it: read-only, for at most {minutes} minutes, and every page they open is logged.
support.empty_text: When your service provider asks to look inside, the request appears here for you to approve or reject.
support.approve_text: They can view, not change, for {minutes} minutes from now. You can end it at any time.
support.revoke_text: They are signed out of your organization straight away.

export.title: Export your data
export.text: Download everything this organization holds, as one ZIP file. You can do this at any time, even if your service provider stops.
export.preparing: This can take a few minutes. You can leave this page; the export keeps going.
export.failed: Something went wrong while preparing it. Please try again.
export.expired: This file has been deleted. Prepare a new export.
export.empty_text: Prepare an export to get a copy of all your data.
export.formats: Each set comes as JSON (for moving to another system) and CSV (opens in Excel), with a manifest describing the contents. Download links work for 5 minutes; files are deleted automatically after a few days.

partner.title: Support access
partner.text: Ask a client for time-limited, read-only access when you need to look at a problem. The client decides; every page you open is recorded in their audit log.
partner.request_title: Ask a client for support access
partner.request_text: The client sees your name, the reason, the severity and the time you ask for.
partner.client_required: Choose the client you need to look at.
partner.minutes_hint: The client's own limit may shorten it.
partner.reason_hint: Say what you will look at. At least 10 characters.
partner.reason_placeholder: e.g. Ticket #1432: invoices do not show the VAT line; I need to check the settings.
partner.reason_short: Please explain in at least 10 characters.
partner.empty_text: When a client needs help, ask for access here.
partner.empty_text_other: Support requests from your team appear here.
